part_id.description: Moving part (or the smaller part of an adjacent pair)
part_id.title: Part Id

min_clearance.description: Minimum distance, mm (Measured with BRepExtrema; over the motion range when moving)

volume.description: Boolean intersection volume, mm³ (Measured; tolerance 0.01 mm³)

kind.description: interference = parts that move relative to each other (different rigid bodies, not joint partners) or the two shells of a parting line overlap → fail; joint_seat = overlap between the two parts of one joint (seat / insertion depth of concept geometry); static_overlap = parts of one rigid body interpenetrate (concept geometry, pocket at detail design)
kind.title: Kind

parent.description: part_id of the parent (the part that carries the joint)
parent.title: Parent

dof.description: Degrees of freedom of the child relative to the parent (0 rigid, 1 revolute / linear)
dof.title: Dof

origin_mm.description: Joint origin, mm, GLB axes (+Y up)
origin_mm.title: Origin Mm

rule.description: Why this mate: the family / role rule that inferred it
rule.title: Rule

rigid_body.description: Parts with the same number move together (connected by rigid joints)
rigid_body.title: Rigid Body

explode_vector.description: Unit vector, GLB axes; derived from the joint
explode_vector.title: Explode Vector

explode_distance_mm.description: Cumulative along the tree (a child moves with its parent)
explode_distance_mm.title: Explode Distance Mm

lcsc_pn.description: e.g. 'C725790' when matched to the LCSC snapshot
lcsc_pn.title: Lcsc Pn

BuildStrategy.description:
W21: how this product realistically gets built — design everything, assemble bought-in modules, or customise an
ODM reference platform. Figures are Estimates with their assumptions.

not_customisable.description: What comes from the modules / the ODM platform
not_customisable.title: Not Customisable

entry_cost.description: Typical entry cost (NRE, tooling, certification) before the first order, Estimate

lead_time.description: Typical time from frozen design to first production units (weeks), Estimate

path.description: Realistic steps (for ODM: find a close reference platform…)
path.title: Path

BuildStrategy.title: BuildStrategy

format.description: py (W21): the build123d program of the model, served by GET /projects/<pid>/cad/code/<n>

standard.description: e.g. FCC Part 15B, CE (LVD/EMC/RED), UKCA, UN38.3
standard.title: Standard

reasons.description: e.g. EOL, single source, long lead time, low stock
reasons.title: Reasons

unit_cost.description: Ex-works unit cost (FOB basis) at this tier

margin_pct.description: Margin at target retail price, landed-cost estimate basis

rule_citation.description: The rule the finding is based on, with its source
rule_citation.title: Rule Citation

C3 (additive): one 2D technical drawing sheet of a version — GET /projects/{id}/drawings?version=n (CAD_DRAWINGS=1).
Orthographic views (first angle) + isometric, dimensions measured on the STEP, ISO 2768-m title block.

sheet.description: Sheet id within the version: 'A1' assembly, 'P01'… parts, 'M01'… moulded shells (DFM model)
sheet.title: Sheet

part_id.description: GLB part_id (PartMeta.part_id) drawn on a part sheet; None on the assembly
part_id.title: Part Id

set_pdf_url.description: /files/<pid>/drawings/v<n>_set.pdf — every sheet of the version, one PDF
set_pdf_url.title: Set Pdf Url

scale.description: Scale of the orthographic views, ISO 5455 standard, e.g. '1:2'
scale.title: Scale

bbox_mm.description: Overall [x, y, z] measured on the STEP (Z up)
bbox_mm.title: Bbox Mm

note.const: Generated from CAD — verify before release
note.default: Generated from CAD — verify before release

DrawingSheet.title: DrawingSheet

pcb_note.default: PCB layout: next step (human or text-to-PCB)

category.description: Engineering category key, e.g. wearable, furniture_baby, home_robot, vacuum, irrigation, solar_roof, surfboard, lighting, tracker, generic

inputs_digest.description: Hash of the project state this was computed from

build_strategy.description: W21: full design / module assembly / ODM customisation

threshold.description: Human wording of the pass/warn/fail rule, e.g. '≥ 15° (design target)'

formula.description: Formula and assumptions, with the inputs' labels

notes.description: e.g. the sealing checklist of an IP check
